longTestimonial: Jerry and Joan are truly exceptional, thoughtful art experts.  From the very  beginning, they guided us through our first purchase with care and professionalism, making the experience both enjoyable and rewarding.  They understood exactly what we were collecting, and when another remarkable piece became available, they reached out right away.  Thanks to their attentiveness, we now own two wonderful works of art - and both acquisitions came through two equally wonderful people.  Their dedication, insight, and genuine service have made our journey into collecting not only successful but deeply meaningful.
